sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2 which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

ال 
المواصفات الفنية للتوربين KVA = 2155، F = 50، V = 3150، A = 395، 
السرعة = 1000 دورة في الدقيقة، Vexci = 60 فولت، Iexci = 6.4A

The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El 
Mohsen Mohamed; Manager of Nag Hammady Hydraulic PS, and certified by eng. Kamal 
Ragheb Haleem HPGC "MPIS Coordinator & QC general Director"
